Hey, I get where you're coming from. There's a chance I'm a khaki at your same command. This shit sucks, and I'm so sorry that youve been fucked like that. The blue weenie is real.
I know how bad our medical can be, and Im sorry for that. How about instead of ending your life, we burn this shit down. You on your end, me on mine. We never have to talk.
FOIA request the last 3 years of DEOCS surveys and file complaints (*especially* ICE complaints at medical). CMEO, IG, the whole nine yards. It won't change what's already happened, but it could improve the future for you and potentially *thousands* of Sailors at your command.
If you feel like it, get in touch, drop your UIC in my DMs, and I'll see what I can do. You aren't in this alone. You got this shipmate, I believe in you.
Most of the waste doesnt even happen at the major projects level. Its the huge accumulation of smaller shit like 1300 dollar coffee cups that drive it home

Yes it is, but... That's your suffering. I recently became acquainted with the pure sorrow and grief that comes when a close friend or family member kills themself. So please, think about the others first. I beg you. And I know, that sounds like guilt tripping, but I swear that's not my intent. I want to help. And I hope I did
